scope: Private diagnostic for valid unsigned JPEG 2000 precision, without a product or competitor support claim. No transform, ROI, palette, opacity, signed interpretation or file-layout extension is inferred from these controls.

requirements.status: Unprobed: independently authored 17-, 24-, 31-, 32- and 38-bit unsigned samples, exact native integer expectations and paired 16-bit codec/RGB PDF controls. Existing product precision refusal remains an implementation gap.
requirements.rule: PDF permits 1–38 component bits. T.800 Table A.11 conditions representability on coefficient growth and coding bounds. E-2 permits at most 37 nominal magnitude planes without ROI because G≤7 and epsilon≤31. The 38-bit subject therefore uses unsigned 1 rather than 0: its centered magnitude is 2^37−1, representable in 37 planes. The remaining samples are 2^(P−2), 2^(P−1), 2^P−1. These exact integers are not reduced to a 16-bit API. Enumerated unsigned gray maps x/(2^P−1) to the sRGB nonlinearity; independent nearest-byte expectations are 0,64,128,255.
requirements.boundaries: No full ROI claim: Table A.26 permits shifts 0–255 and H.1 shifts coded magnitude planes. The coefficient representation and its explicit resource/precision admission bound require separate review. A passing byte rendering cannot prove preservation of the low-order sample bits; native/interleaved acceptance is required. The 38-bit unsigned zero endpoint is deliberately absent rather than encoded with an invalid guard/exponent field. The one-byte display tolerance is fixed before observation; RGB controls are exact.
